summary: ```markdown # Learning Day - Denim Clothing Production p01: Producing Shirts ## Introduction Good evening everyone, I am Xuanli from the Chinese team of Icy Marvelous Design. In today's live course, we will learn how to make this set of jeans. A few days ago, we started the 5th edition of the 3D props competition with Lurtis Studio. The registration period for this episode is until September 5th. If you are interested, you can watch our previous videos to sign up. The theme of this episode is "Western Salon." I have prepared a live course about how to make this set of jeans, and I hope it can help you. ## Overview of the Set Let's take a look at the overall effect of this set of clothes. It includes a jacket, a triangle, a shirt, jeans, etc. In today's video, I will show you how to make this set of jeans. It will take a long time, so you can prepare a small plate of snacks to watch this video. This video will have a live broadcast, and the follow-up live broadcast will be uploaded to the official account of Marvelous Designer, MD Official. ## Preparing the Model First of all, you can see that I made this set of clothes with a basic model. The body shape of this model is a little stronger. So, if we import this set of T-shirt files from Marvelous Designer, you will see that it will pass through the human body. This is because the size of this human body is a little bigger than the male body shape of this set of clothes. This model file will be uploaded in the later part of today's live broadcast, so if you want to learn with this, you can click on the comment section below the video. ## Adjusting the Board As you can see, because our body shape is a little bigger than the T-shirt body shape of the original T-shirt, we need to rearrange the board to prevent interference with the model during the arrangement process. Sometimes, it cannot return to the correct place of wearing by itself. So, we need to rearrange the board. When arranging the board, there is a tab on the right side of the selectable board. Adjusting this tab can keep the board away from the body of the virtual model. After the adjustment is complete, we will start to adjust the board. When we make clothes in the software, the first thing to modify is its overall shape, and then we need to increase it. We also need to add some other details. ## Modifying the Internal Layer When we are making the most internal layer of this shirt, we know that this set of clothes is not compatible with this model. We can open the hard drive to see the model. It has some pressure on the top; that is, the pressure is relatively large. Since this is the case, we need to adjust the board to fit the body shape of the virtual model. Before we adjust the board, because this set of clothes is a relatively tight dress, all of our models have an air thickness around them, which is the surface diameter. When our board has a larger particle diameter, it is difficult to see some of its fold effect. So for this dress, I have already reduced its particle diameter in the previous period, and the thickness of the board has been reduced. This is also to make it easier to see the fold effect. ## Issues with Tight Design In the process of moving the board, you will see that when I move the board, because the board is too tight, the fold effect is not very beautiful. This fold effect is not what I imagined. This means that when you make some tight designs in Marvelous Designer, you might think, "I have already made it very tight. Why doesn't it still have a fold effect?" In fact, sometimes if you use this board, its stretch performance is better, or the clothes are too tight; it will not form a fold effect. Because this board is strongly stretched, it does not create the amount of fold effect here. So, tightness does not mean that the board must be reduced by five fingers. ## Creating a Close-Up Board Now let's take a look at how to make a close-up, but not too tight, board. As I just mentioned, our model has a surface diameter, which is the air thickness around the model. Here we need to reduce the surface diameter to 1 or 0 to make the air thickness around the model thinner, so that the board is closer to the body. Then, I will choose to give the sleeve a counter-activation first. When you counter-activate the sleeve, the sleeve will no longer have pull on the big body. If you simulate the sleeve and the big body at the same time, when you adjust the shape of the board, it is very difficult for you to control their fold direction together. ## Adjusting the Pressure Diagram Now that I have counter-activated the sleeve, let's simulate the big body separately. Take a look at the pressure diagram. You will see that the bottom of the page is a dark area. What is the difference between counter-activation and cold movement? We have explained it many times in previous teaching videos. If you have time, you can take a look at the technique sharing video, where most of the basic principle problems can be found. Since the bottom of the page is red, we will modify the bottom of the page. It is tight here, so we will pull the bottom of the page down a little bit so that it is not too close to the bottom of the page. After we adjust it far away from the page, it still has a red area, which proves that it has nothing to do with the high and low points of the sleeve. Instead, we need to widen its chest. ## Final Adjustments After adjusting the waist, you can see that its entire curve is not very smooth, and it is not very good-looking. In this case, we will first pull the point of its waist out a little bit. After that, since what I am going to do now is a tight style, you can open the transparent picture by pressing Alt + 4. After opening the transparent picture, we will see that the curve on the side of this piece of clothing is not in line with the curve of the human body. So here we need to add two more straight lines in the thinnest position of the waist. After adding two more straight lines, we go back to the previous mode, which shows the pattern of the page. ## Conclusion After completing the adjustments, we sew the panels together and simulate again. If everything is stable, we can proceed with the next steps in the design. Thank you for joining me in this live course, and I hope you found it helpful for your denim clothing production journey. ```
